sources.title: ESPN defense and special teams scoring
McCaffrey absent from open practice; no official designation yet
Nabers returns to team drills during ACL recovery
Skattebo discusses his return from injury
Mahomes reports progress after knee surgery
Rice cleared for camp after knee procedure
NFL places Jacobs on Commissioner’s Exempt List
Seattle’s initial roster and Charbonnet’s PUP status
Pacheco to IR; Chase and Higgins practice updates
McVay expects Nacua to play Week 1
Buffalo reports Bass healthy on initial roster

availability.name: Christian McCaffrey
availability.note: Missed the media-open portion of practice. No official injury designation was supplied in that report; do not infer a diagnosis or a missed game.

availability.name: Malik Nabers
availability.note: Returned to limited team reps after ACL surgery. That August checkpoint did not settle Week 1 availability; Clay still models 17 games.

availability.name: Cam Skattebo
availability.note: Described himself as ready to return after last season’s leg injury. Recovery history warrants monitoring; it does not establish a new injury probability.

availability.name: Patrick Mahomes
availability.note: Cleared for camp after knee surgery and reported progress. The report uses Clay’s 17-game estimate, with no extra automatic penalty.

availability.name: Rashee Rice
availability.note: Cleared for camp following a knee procedure. His 2025 suspension is not carried into the 2026 calculations.

availability.name: Josh Jacobs
availability.note: On the Commissioner’s Exempt List. A return date is uncertain; Clay models 11 games, not guaranteed availability.

availability.name: Zach Charbonnet
availability.note: Opens the season on PUP following an ACL injury. Clay’s 11-game projection already includes a reduced season.

availability.name: Isiah Pacheco
availability.note: Placed on injured reserve. Clay models 12 games; that is an estimate rather than a confirmed return schedule.

availability.name: Ja'Marr Chase
availability.note: Limited with a knee issue in the September 1 update. The coach expressed optimism; this report does not assign missed games.

availability.name: Tee Higgins
availability.note: Reported heel contusion. The September 1 update described no major Week 1 concern; check later practice reports.

availability.name: Puka Nacua
availability.note: McVay expected him to play Week 1. The report also mentioned camp soreness and a pending league review; no suspension is assumed here.

availability.name: Tyler Bass
availability.note: Buffalo described him as healthy on its initial roster. Missing from the frozen Top 300 does not mean unavailable or unsigned.
